cover.coreProposition: Self-evolving procedures must remain candidate control state until an explicit adoption gate evaluates evidence not used to generate the proposal; the active procedure keeps a separate stable identity until that gate passes.
cover.visualMetaphor: A translucent amber form approaches a luminous cyan threshold while a stable violet structure remains anchored beyond it.
cover.semanticObject: A provisional glass form, a bright threshold, and a separately anchored active structure
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with deep navy depth, one amber candidate form, one cyan threshold, one stable violet form, and generous negative space
